basic_details.job_title: Manipur University Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Life Sciences (Botany), School of Life Sciences, Manipur University (A Central University), Canchipur, Imphal, has invited applications for one temporary Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post in a Department of Biotechnology, Govt. of India sponsored 2-year research project. The emolument is Rs. 37,000 + 9% HRA, and the essential qualification is an M.Sc. degree in Botany/Plant Sciences/Biotechnology with CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) or a qualifying national level examination. Applications go to the Principal Investigator by email or hard copy by 0

how_to_apply: Prepare the application in the format of Annexure I (Application Form for JRF), neatly typed on plain white A4 paper with full bio-data.
Affix a self-attested recent passport size colour photograph at the place marked on the form.

Fill the form items: post applied for, name, date of birth, age as on 30.11.2026, correspondence address, mobile number, email, qualifications (M.Sc., B.Sc., 12th, 10th with university, year, subject and percentage/GPA), NET and GATE details, experience, SCI publications and signature.
Attach copies of all relevant supporting documents.
Send the application to the Principal Investigator by email at [email protected], or as a hard copy, by 05 December 2026.
important_instructions: No TA/DA and no official accommodation will be provided for appearing in the interview. Candidates are requested to bring the original certificates, mark sheets and other relevant documents, along with the application and copies of the documents mentioned. If any information is found incorrect or any fact is concealed, the candidature or selection is liable to be cancelled at any stage.

content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice invites highly motivated eligible candidates for the JRF post (1 post). The application form (Annexure 1) asks for the candidate's age as on 30.11.2026, but the notice prints no age limit. It also asks for NET/JRF details (CSIR-UGC NET including LS/DBT JRF/ICMR-JRF/ICAR-NET), GATE details, experience and the number of publications in SCI journals, if any. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility detail.

rows.essential_qualification: M.Sc. degree in Botany/Plant Sciences/Biotechnology with CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) or through National level examination conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The emolument for the JRF post is Rs. 37,000 + 9% HRA. The project is a 2-year project. The post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. The selected candidate has no right to claim regularization or absorption in Manipur University. The selection committee reserves the right to terminate the contract even before the project is completed, and no appeal is entertained.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Manipur University Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Prepare the application in the format of Annexure I (Application Form for JRF), neatly typed on plain white A4 paper with full bio-data. Affix a self-attested recent passport size colour photograph at the place marked on the form. Fill the form items: post applied for, name, date of birth, age as on 30.11.2026, correspondence address, mobile number, email, qualifications (M.Sc., B.Sc., 12th, 10th with university, year, subject and percentage/GPA), NET and GATE details, experience, SCI publications and signature. Attach copies of all relevant supporting documents. Send the application to the Principal Investigator by email at [email protected] , or as a hard copy, by 05 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be intimated for a personal interview through email. The interview date and venue are not specified in the notice. Candidates are to bring the original certificates and mark sheets, and the originals will be verified at the time of interview. The decision of the selection committee is final and binding in all aspects.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA and no official accommodation will be provided for appearing in the interview. Candidates are requested to bring the original certificates, mark sheets and other relevant documents, along with the application and copies of the documents mentioned. If any information is found incorrect or any fact is concealed, the candidature or selection is liable to be cancelled at any stage.
